response.sql: WITH per_event AS (SELECT link_to_event, AVG(amount) AS avg_amount FROM budget WHERE link_to_event IS NOT NULL GROUP BY link_to_event HAVING AVG(amount) IS NOT NULL), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_amount) AS overall_avg FROM per_event), kept AS (SELECT p.link_to_event, p.avg_amount, o.overall_avg FROM per_event p CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE p.avg_amount > o.overall_avg), kept_mean AS (SELECT AVG(avg_amount) AS kept_avg FROM kept) SELECT k.link_to_event, k.avg_amount, k.avg_amount - k.overall_avg AS above_overall_avg, k.avg_amount - m.kept_avg AS diff_from_kept_mean FROM kept k CROSS JOIN kept_mean m ORDER BY diff_from_kept_mean DESC LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: Budget rows with a NULL link_to_event are not treated as an event and are excluded. Events whose amounts are all NULL have no average and are excluded from the overall mean.
Ties at the top 10 cutoff are broken arbitrarily.
